tools.name: book_demo
tools.description: Open the DirectMail.io demo booking calendar. Use when a user wants to talk to sales, get a product demo, or schedule a call with the team.

tools.name: browse_resources
tools.description: Open the DirectMail.io resources library — cheat sheets, rate cards, buyer checklists. Use when a user wants downloadable reference material.

tools.name: estimate_postage
tools.description: Estimate USPS postage cost per piece and total cost for a direct mail campaign. Use for any cost question about postcards, letters, EDDM, First-Class Mail, Marketing Mail, presort, or co-mingle.

tools.name: lookup_glossary_term
tools.description: Look up a direct mail or USPS postal term (NCOA, CASS, DPV, IMb, Pre-sort, Co-mingle, Scan Trigger, Informed Delivery, etc.) in the DirectMail.io glossary.
